description: baseline

Implement an independent CUDA C++ modified Gram-Schmidt QR path for QR_v2 small/medium shapes, using one CTA or CTA-group per matrix, shared-memory column storage, warp/block reductions for dot/norm, and batched grids that expose enough matrices/tiles to saturate the GPU.
CUDA Householder QR path for n=32 with torch.geqrf fallback
Attempted templated n=176/n=352 CUDA path but validation subprocess loaded stale binding lacking qr176; reset to prior good commit
Retried n=176 CUDA path with fresh extension name; validation subprocess still saw extension without qr176 binding; reset to safe qr32 commit
Correctly bound n=176 shared-memory CUDA path failed validation with invalid launch argument, likely excessive dynamic shared memory; reset to qr32 path

Medium n=176/n=352 shared-memory CTA attempts failed validation (binding mistake twice, then invalid launch likely dynamic shared memory), reset to safe commit. Profile saved under autocuda/profiles//worker1-brief0-iter0-6b4cad26354ae22870317aaf71ed821d71aa10f0.nsys-rep.

Implement a native CUDA C++ large-n batched QR fast path for n=512/1024 using blocked Householder panels with compact WY representation: fixed small panel width in shared memory, panel/tau only in shared memory, global-memory trailing updates across batched grids, targeting torch-fallback overhead and insufficient large-n parallelism while explicitly avoiding full-matrix dynamic shared memory.
Native one-CTA global-memory Householder QR route for n=512; validates but is slower than torch fallback on n=512 benchmark cases
Native one-CTA global-memory Householder QR route for n=1024 only; validates but is far slower than torch fallback
Guarded n=512 rank-deficient CUDA QR route factors first 384 columns and zeros trailing columns; dense/mixed/other large shapes fall back to torch.geqrf
GPU tail-zero detector for n=512 rank-deficient route; validates but slightly slower than torch max/abs guard

Combined n<=352 CUDA QR, safe n4096 upper/rank-deficient structured routes, and guarded n512 rank-deficient CUDA QR with fallback for dense/mixed/unsupported shapes
Removed n1024/n2048 rank-tail geqrf route from combined dispatch; keeps n<=352 CUDA QR, n4096 upper, and n512 rank-deficient CUDA QR

Replaced n<=352 predicate with exact small-shape dispatch and specialized n4096 tau allocation; validates but regresses vs parent
